title: 第一卷 第6章 想不想我喜欢上你？
content_zh:
童喻定神。

    原本退后的步子又收了回来，还往前一步，和他靠得很近。

    近距离能闻到童喻身上淡淡的清香味，不是香水，是衣服和发香。

    那晚，他闻过她的香，勾得他沉迷其中，无法自拔。

    一向对主动靠近的女人是厌恶至极的。

    更不可能发生关系。

    她，让他破了例。

    还破了身。

    霍放在她靠过来的时候往后面的沙发上一坐，手快速贴紧她的腰。

    她整个人扑在他的身上。

    喉咙里发出一声性感的轻笑。

    垂眸看她，“你还真是主动。”

    这个男人真是有颠倒黑白的能力。

    童喻的手撑在他的胸膛，掌心贴着他的心跳。腰上的手在轻轻抚摸，她赶紧撑起来。

    后腰一重，她又被压了下去，看起来是她故意亲近他。

    童喻睁大双眼，盯着眼前恶趣味十足的男人。

    “二少，你再这样，我会以为你是真的喜欢我了。”

    童喻索性不动了。

    反正，已经这样了。

    霍放双眸在她脸上来回，未施粉黛，皮肤细腻，那双眼睛更是清透动人。

    粉唇鲜嫩，轻抿着，像一朵含苞欲放的花，绽放着幽幽清香。

    “你想不想我喜欢上你？”

    他的气息喷洒在她脸上，细细密密的灼烧着她的脸。

    童喻总觉着他这句话的意思不正经。

    可她，又找不到证据。

    虽然是她压着他的，但显然她一直处于下风，被他拿捏着。

    他的手掌贴着她的腰，她的手就试探着放在他的腹部上，猛然绷紧。

    霍放眸光微缩。

    他不由想到了那晚，她的手在他身上划过，他发了狠。

    从来没有想到有一天，他会沦陷在一个不熟且心机颇深的女人身上。

    童喻放大了胆子，手掌再往下一寸，就看到他喉结动了动。

    “我想，二少就会吗？”

    霍放咽了咽喉咙，垂眸看向那只贴在他小腹下的手掌，“看来，你是吃定我了。”

    他在笑，眼神却带着几分凉薄。

    童喻会察言观色，她知道适可而止。

    眼前这个男人，她不能惹毛了。

    只要还想在夜场混，就得哄着他。

    童喻的手拿开，直起了腰，漂亮的眼睛望进他深邃的眼眸里。

    “像二少这样的男人，大多数女人都会心存幻想，想要成为二少心中的例外吧。”

    霍放后背靠着沙发，笑意越来越深。

    那笑，在童喻看来，就是在看笑话。
content_en:
Tong Yu calms the mind.

    She took back her steps back and took a step forward, getting very close to him.

    From a close distance, you can smell the faint fragrance of Tong Yu's body. It's not perfume, but the fragrance of clothes and hair.

    That night, he smelled her fragrance, which made him addicted and unable to extricate himself.

    He has always been extremely disgusted with women who approach him.

    It's even more impossible to have a relationship.

    She made him make an exception.

    Also broke.

    Huo sat down on the sofa behind her when she came over, and quickly put his hand close to her waist.

    She threw herself all over him.

    A sexy chuckle escaped his throat.

    He lowered his eyes and looked at her, "You really took the initiative."

    This man really has the ability to confuse right and wrong.

    Tong Yu placed her hands on his chest, her palms touching his heartbeat. The hands on her waist were caressing her gently, and she quickly stood up.

    A heavy weight on her lower back pushed her down again. It seemed like she was getting close to him on purpose.

    Tong Yu opened his eyes wide and stared at the naughty man in front of him.

    "Second Young Master, if you keep doing this, I will think you really like me."

    Tong Yu simply stopped moving.

    Anyway, that’s it.

    Huo Fang's eyes were running back and forth on her face. She had no powder on her face, her skin was delicate, and her eyes were clear and moving.

    The pink lips are fresh and tender, pursed lightly, like a budding flower, blooming with a faint fragrance.

    "Do you want me to fall in love with you?"

    His breath sprayed on her face, burning her face finely.

    Tong Yu always felt that the meaning of his words was not serious.

    But she couldn't find any evidence.

    Although she was the one holding him down, it was obvious that she had been at a disadvantage and was being manipulated by him.

    His palms were against her waist, and her hands tentatively placed on his abdomen, suddenly tightening.

    Huo Fang's eyes narrowed.

    He couldn't help but think of that night, when her hands crossed his body and he became angry.

    He never thought that one day, he would fall for an unfamiliar and scheming woman.

    Tong Yu became more courageous, and when he moved his palm an inch lower, he saw his Adam's apple move.

    "I wonder if the Second Young Master can do it?"

    Huo Fang swallowed his throat and lowered his eyes to look at the palm attached to his lower abdomen. "It seems that you have convinced me."

    He was smiling, but his eyes were a little cold.

    Tong Yu is good at observing words and expressions, and she knows when enough is enough.

    She couldn't offend the man in front of her.

    As long as you still want to hang out in the nightclub, you have to coax him.

    Tong Yu took his hand away, straightened up, and looked into his deep eyes with her beautiful eyes.

    "For a man like the Second Young Master, most women will have fantasies and want to be the exception in the Second Young Master's heart."

    Huo Fang leaned back on the sofa, his smile getting deeper and deeper.

    That smile, in Tong Yu's opinion, was like watching a joke.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 6 Do you want me to fall in love with you?
